_comment: Golden fixture for atlas_cache TTL boundary contract (AC-6). Pins the exact semantics: age strictly < ttl_days is FRESH (HIT, no fetch); age >= ttl_days is STALE (MISS, fetch called). Rows are pre-seeded with a fetched_at in ISO-8601 UTC. Tests derive their clock from the fixture, never hardcoding producer values.

cases.description: age is (ttl_days * 86400 - 1) seconds — strictly less than ttl_days — must be FRESH
age is exactly ttl_days * 86400 seconds — must be STALE
age is (ttl_days * 86400 + 1) seconds — strictly greater than ttl_days — must be STALE
row just written (age 0 seconds) — must be FRESH
